name: VPS staging full corpus acceptance runbook
database_assumption: MySQL/MariaDB database runs on the user's VPS or private VPS LAN.
important_status: The package still embeds only the 80-entry preview subset. The >=1000 full corpus must be downloaded/imported on the user's VPS staging environment with internet access.
required_steps: Run VPS DB backup before import.
Run full corpus builder with --download --min-entries 1000 on staging.
Validate entry count, dialect coverage, source PHON coverage, audio URL coverage, duplicate count, and license blockers.
Generate SQL seed or direct DB import.
Run acceptance report and only promote to full_corpus_verified after review.
never_do: Do not import directly into production before staging report passes.
Do not expose synthetic TTS as real pronunciation.
